count.description: Total number of entries in this bin.

percent.description: Percentage of the total histogram represented by this bucket.

start.description:
If the data was numeric, startValue will be set.

start (inclusive) specifies the value range start that is covered by this bin

end.description:
If the data was numeric, endValue will be set.

end (exclusive) specifies the value range end that is covered by this bin

title:
Represents a single bin in a Histogram. A HistogramBin includes all information about elements within a particular
range of values. A collection of HistogramBin contains all information for a Histogram.
name: HistogramBin
